scope: Both already-prepared 10Mb BAM cohorts; development only. Their genotype-truth controls were inspected, but no full BAM estimates have been viewed.
method: ANGSD0.940-tag GL2/doSaf1 minMapQ30 minQ20; winsfs0.7.0; global folding; unchanged v5 moments demographic fitter with8 starts each L-BFGS-B andPowell.

window_settings.continuation: first seed initialized from its first unfolded SFS

changed_from_1Mb_window_development: Increase maximum epoch cap from20 to50 without changing the stopping threshold; seed1 on1Mb Task14 hit20. No old run is relabeled.

numerical_acceptance.contract: Full20 diploids, coherent matching10Mb reference/BAM dictionary, expected populations and hashes.
numerical_acceptance.winsfs: Each initial/alternate-seed/continued run must satisfy its normalized-block1e-4 stop before50epochs. This is explicitly not the realSFS stopping rule.
numerical_acceptance.optimizer: Each run must pass unchanged v5 two-optimizer agreement/interior-best gates.
numerical_acceptance.target_stability: Every requested target must change by less than1% in both the alternate-seed and continued runs relative to seed1.
numerical_acceptance.spectrum_stability: Both comparisons must have full-frequencyL1<0.001 and segregating-bin relativeL1<0.05. These window-estimator criteria are separate from the earlier realSFS criteria, which remain unpassed.

scientific_acceptance: All requested targets absolute relative error<=0.30; unchanged development recovery threshold. Full-width single-case success does not establish multi-regime readiness.
confirmation: Remains unlaunched. Freeze an entire policy only after complete development comparisons; then require all three regimes/two seeds per task in validation_acceptance_v1.json. Exposure/optimizer/recovery criteria unchanged; window-specific numerical criteria above must be prospectively frozen.
compute: At most2 concurrent4CPU Slurm jobs with5632M/CPU. Each full comparison capped1hour. Matched1Mb checks finish before full runs launch.
